/-- One Montgomery reduction step: `part1 sum` computes `p = sum * LFACTOR mod 2^52` and the
carry `(sum + p * L[0]) / 2^52`, where the division is exact. -/
@[progress]
theorem part1_spec (sum : U128) (h : sum.val < 2 ^ 127) :
    part1 sum ⦃ r =>
      r.2.val < 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.2.val = sum.val * constants.LFACTOR.val % 2 ^ 52 ∧
      (sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 ∧
      r.1.val = (sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val) / 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val * 2 ^ 52 = sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val ⦄ := by
  unfold part1
  progress as ⟨ i, hi ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i1, hi1 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i2, hi2 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i3, hi3 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ p, hp ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i4, hi4, hi4' ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i5, hi5 ⟩
  have hL0 : i4.val = 671914833335277 := by rw [hi4', constants.L_val]; rfl
  have hLF := constants.LFACTOR_val
  have hi3v : i3.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hi3, hi2]; simp only [U64.size, U64.numBits, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; norm_num
  have hpv : p.val = sum.val * constants.LFACTOR.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
    rw [hp, UScalar.val_and, hi3v, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod, hi1,
      core.num.U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq, hi, UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    simp only [UScalarTy.numBits, show UScalar.size UScalarTy.U64 = 2 ^ 64 by simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]]
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64), Nat.mul_mod,
      Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64), ← Nat.mul_mod]
  have hplt : p.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hpv]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  have hdiv : (sum.val + p.val * i4.val) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 := by
    rw [hpv, hL0, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_mod, ← Nat.mul_mod, ← Nat.add_mod, hLF]
    have : sum.val + sum.val * 1439961107955227 * 671914833335277 =
        sum.val * (1439961107955227 * 671914833335277 + 1) := by ring
    rw [this, Nat.mul_mod]
    norm_num
  have hi5lt : i5.val < 2 ^ 102 := by
    rw [hi5, hL0]
    calc p.val * 671914833335277 < 2 ^ 52 * 2 ^ 50 :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le hplt (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      _ = 2 ^ 102 := by norm_num
  have hadd : sum.val + i5.val ≤ U128.max := by
    rw [U128.max_eq]
    have : (2 : ℕ) ^ 127 + 2 ^ 102 ≤ 340282366920938463463374607431768211455 := by norm_num
    omega
  progress as ⟨ i6, hi6 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i7, hi7 ⟩
  simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] at hi7
  rw [constants.L_limbs.1, ← hL0]
  refine ⟨hplt, hpv, hdiv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hi7, hi6, hi5]
  · rw [hi7, hi6, hi5]
    exact Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hdiv)

`sum % 2^52`. -/
@[progress]
theorem part2_spec (sum : U128) :
    part2 sum ⦃ r =>
      r.2.val < 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.2.val = sum.val % 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val = sum.val / 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 76 ∧
      r.1.val * 2 ^ 52 + r.2.val = sum.val ⦄ := by
  unfold part2
  progress as ⟨ i, hi ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i1, hi1 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i2, hi2 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ w, hw ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i3, hi3 ⟩
  simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] at hi3
  have hi2v : i2.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hi2, hi1]; simp only [U64.size, U64.numBits, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; norm_num
  have hwv : w.val = sum.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
    rw [hw, UScalar.val_and, hi2v, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod, hi, UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    simp only [UScalarTy.numBits,
      show UScalar.size UScalarTy.U64 = 2 ^ 64 by simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]]
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64)]

  refine ⟨?_, hwv, hi3, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hwv]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  · rw [hi3]; omega
  · rw [hi3, hwv]; exact Nat.div_add_mod' _ _

/-- `sub a b` computes `a - b` modulo `L`: for limbs below `2^52` and `b ≤ a + L`, the result has
limbs below `2^52` and `r + b = a + (a < b ? L : 0)`. In particular `r ≡ a + L - b [MOD L]`,
and `r < L` whenever `a < b + L`. -/
@[progress]
theorem sub_spec (a b : Scalar52)
    (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hb : ∀ j, j < 5 → (b.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hab : Scalar52_as_Nat b ≤ Scalar52_as_Nat a + _root_.L) :
    sub a b ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r + Scalar52_as_Nat b =
        Scalar52_as_Nat a + (if Scalar52_as_Nat a < Scalar52_as_Nat b then _root_.L else 0) ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r ≡ Scalar52_as_Nat a + _root_.L - Scalar52_as_Nat b [MOD _root_.L] ∧
      (Scalar52_as_Nat a < Scalar52_as_Nat b + _root_.L → Scalar52_as_Nat r < _root_.L) ⦄ := by
  unfold sub
  progress as ⟨i, hi⟩
  progress as ⟨mask, hmask⟩
  have hmv : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hmask, hi]; simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, U64.size, U64.numBits]
  have hz : ∀ j, j < 5 → (ZERO.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
    intro j _; rw [ZERO_val_getElem!]; simp
  progress with sub_loop_spec as ⟨d, _, hd2, hd3, hd4⟩
  progress as ⟨i1, hi1⟩
  progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
  have hi1v : i1.val = d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 := by simp [hi1, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  have hi2v : i2.val = d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 := by
    rw [← hi1v, hi2, UScalar.cast_val_eq]; simp; omega
  progress with sub_choice_from_spec as ⟨c, hc⟩
  progress with conditional_add_l_spec as ⟨res, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩
  have hcond : (c.val = 1#u8) ↔ d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 = 1 := by
    rw [hc]; constructor
    · intro h; rw [← hi2v, h]; rfl
    · intro h; apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; rw [hi2v, h]; rfl
  have hD := sub_as_Nat_lt d.1 hd2
  have hR := sub_as_Nat_lt res.2 hr1
  have hloop : (Scalar52_as_Nat d.1 : Int) - 2 ^ 260 * ((d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) =
      (Scalar52_as_Nat a : Int) - Scalar52_as_Nat b := by
    rw [← sub_Ico_sum_sub, ← conditional_add_l_Ico_sum_eq d.1]

import Curve25519Dalek.Funs
import Curve25519Dalek.Math.Basic

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result Aeneas.Std.WP
open curve25519_dalek

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52.Insts.CoreOpsIndexIndexUsizeU64

/-- `index` on a `Scalar52` returns the limb at index `i` (for `i < 5`). -/
@[progress]
theorem index_spec (self : backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52) (i : Std.Usize)
    (hi : i.val < 5) :
    index self i ⦃ x => x = self.val[i.val]! ∧ x.val = self.val[i.val]!.val ⦄ := by
  unfold index
  have hlen : self.val.length = 5 := by simp
  progress as ⟨ x, hx ⟩
  exact ⟨hx, by rw [hx]⟩

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52.Insts.CoreOpsIndexIndexUsizeU64

40	    (i A x c' : Nat) (hi : i < 5)
41	    (hx : x = A + (self.val[i]!).val + Lc i)
42	    (hri : (r.val[i]!).val = x % 2 ^ 52)
43	    (hs1 : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s1.val[j]! = self.val[j]!)
44	    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
45	      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
46	        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * (x / 2 ^ 52)) :

48	      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
49	        2 ^ (52 * i) * A := by

71	`r.2 + 2^260 * (r.1 / 2^52) = self + (condition ? L : 0)`. -/
72	@[progress]
73	theorem conditional_add_l_loop_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
74	    (carry mask : U64) (i : Usize) (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
75	    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) (hcarry : carry.val < 2 ^ 53) :
76	    conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i ⦃ r =>
77	      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.2.val[j]! = self.val[j]!) ∧
78	      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
79	      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
80	      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.2.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
81	        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
82	          (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) +
83	          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) ⦄ := by
84	  unfold conditional_add_l_loop
85	  split
86	  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
87	    progress as ⟨li, hli, hli'⟩
88	    progress with conditional_add_l_select_spec as ⟨addend, haddend⟩
89	    progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
90	    progress as ⟨i3, hi3, hi3'⟩
91	    have hLi : li.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hli']; simpa [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using constants.L_bounds i.val hilt
92	    have hadd : addend.val = (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[i.val]!).val else 0) := by
93	      rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
94	    have hadd_lt : addend.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
95	    have hselfi : i3.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi3']; exact hself i.val hilt
96	    have hi2v : i2.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 := by simp [hi2, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
97	    have hi2lt : i2.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi2v]; omega
98	    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
99	    progress as ⟨carry1, hc1⟩
100	    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
101	    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
102	    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
103	    have hc1v : carry1.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 + (self.val[i.val]!).val + addend.val := by
104	      rw [hc1, hi4, hi2v, hi3']
105	    have hc1lt : carry1.val < 2 ^ 53 := by omega
106	    have hi5v : i5.val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
107	      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
108	    have hs1i : ((back i5).val[i.val]!) = i5 := hback2 i5
109	    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = self.val[j]! := hback3 i5
110	    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
111	      intro j hj
112	      by_cases hji : j = i.val
113	      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
114	      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hself j hj

116	    progress as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
117	    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
118	    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
119	    · rw [hi6] at hr4
120	      have hri : (r.2.val[i.val]!).val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
121	        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v]
122	      exact conditional_add_l_loop_post self (back i5) r.2
123	        (fun j => if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)
124	        i.val (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) carry1.val (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) hilt
125	        (by rw [hc1v, hadd]) hri hs1ne hr4
126	  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
127	    rw [spec_ok]
128	    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hself, hcarry, ?_⟩
129	    simp [hi5]

131	decreasing_by
132	  all_goals scalar_tac
133	
134	end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52
135

137	
138	/-- Splitting the conditional-addend sum into `self + (condition ? L : 0)`. -/
139	theorem conditional_add_l_sum_split (self : Scalar52) (b : Bool) :
140	    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
141	      (if b then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) =
142	      Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if b then _root_.L else 0) := by
143	  rw [← conditional_add_l_Ico_sum_eq self]

145	  · simp
146	  · simp only [if_true, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, conditional_add_l_Ico_sum_eq,
147	      constants.L_spec]

154	    conditional_add_l self condition ⦃ r =>
155	      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
156	      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧

/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
-/
import Curve25519Dalek.Funs
import Curve25519Dalek.Math.Basic
import Curve25519Dalek.Aux
import Curve25519Dalek.Specs.Backend.Serial.U64.Scalar.Scalar52.MontgomeryReduce
import Curve25519Dalek.Specs.Backend.Serial.U64.Scalar.Scalar52.Index
import Curve25519Dalek.Specs.Backend.Serial.U64.Scalar.Scalar52.IndexMut

attribute [-simp] Int.reducePow Nat.reducePow
set_option exponentiation.threshold 260

namespace curve25519_dalek
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Aeneas.Std.WP Result

attribute [-progress] U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select_spec
end curve25519_dalek

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result Aeneas.Std.WP
namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-- Proven (sorry-free) specification of `conditional_select` on `u64`, used locally. -/
theorem conditional_add_l_select_spec (a b : U64) (choice : subtle.Choice) :
    U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select a b choice ⦃ res =>
      res = if choice.val = 1#u8 then b else a ⦄ := by
  unfold U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select
  split <;> simp_all

/-- The full `Ico 0 5` limb sum (as used by `conditional_add_l_loop_spec`) is `Scalar52_as_Nat`. -/
theorem conditional_add_l_Ico_sum_eq (a : Scalar52) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (a.val[j]!).val = Scalar52_as_Nat a := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]

/-- Arithmetic heart of one iteration of `conditional_add_l_loop`. -/
theorem conditional_add_l_loop_post (self s1 r : Array U64 5#usize) (Lc : Nat → Nat)
    (i A x c' : Nat) (hi : i < 5)
    (hx : x = A + (self.val[i]!).val + Lc i)
    (hri : (r.val[i]!).val = x % 2 ^ 52)
    (hs1 : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s1.val[j]! = self.val[j]!)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * (x / 2 ^ 52)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * i) * A := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hs : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hs1 j (by simp at hj; omega)]
  rw [hs] at hrec
  have hsplit := Nat.mod_add_div x (2 ^ 52)
  have hp : 2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize 2 ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  generalize x % 2 ^ 52 = z at *
  generalize x / 2 ^ 52 = y at *
  subst hx
  zify at *
  linear_combination hrec + P * hsplit

/-- `conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i` adds (if `condition` is set) the
limbs `i..4` of `L` to the limbs `i..4` of `self`, propagating the carry and reducing
every limb modulo `2^52`. Started at `i = 0` with `carry = 0`, the result satisfies
`r.2 + 2^260 * (r.1 / 2^52) = self + (condition ? L : 0)`. -/
@[progress]
theorem conditional_add_l_loop_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (carry mask : U64) (i : Usize) (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) (hcarry : carry.val < 2 ^ 53) :
    conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.2.val[j]! = self.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.2.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
          (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) +
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨li, hli, hli'⟩
    progress with conditional_add_l_select_spec as ⟨addend, haddend⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3, hi3'⟩
    have hLi : li.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hli']; simpa [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using constants.L_bounds i.val hilt
    have hadd : addend.val = (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[i.val]!).val else 0) := by
      rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hadd_lt : addend.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hselfi : i3.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi3']; exact hself i.val hilt
    have hi2v : i2.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 := by simp [hi2, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi2lt : i2.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi2v]; omega
    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
    progress as ⟨carry1, hc1⟩
    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
    have hc1v : carry1.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 + (self.val[i.val]!).val + addend.val := by
      rw [hc1, hi4, hi2v, hi3']
    have hc1lt : carry1.val < 2 ^ 53 := by omega
    have hi5v : i5.val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
    have hs1i : ((back i5).val[i.val]!) = i5 := hback2 i5
    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = self.val[j]! := hback3 i5
    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i.val
      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hself j hj
    have hdec : 5 - i6.val < 5 - i.val := by omega
    progress as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
    · rw [hi6] at hr4
      have hri : (r.2.val[i.val]!).val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v]
      exact conditional_add_l_loop_post self (back i5) r.2
        (fun j => if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)
        i.val (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) carry1.val (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) hilt
        (by rw [hc1v, hadd]) hri hs1ne hr4
  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
    rw [spec_ok]
    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hself, hcarry, ?_⟩
    simp [hi5]
termination_by 5 - i.val
decreasing_by
  all_goals scalar_tac

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-- Splitting the conditional-addend sum into `self + (condition ? L : 0)`. -/
theorem conditional_add_l_sum_split (self : Scalar52) (b : Bool) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
      (if b then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) =
      Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if b then _root_.L else 0) := by
  rw [← conditional_add_l_Ico_sum_eq self]
  cases b
  · simp
  · simp only [if_true, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, conditional_add_l_Ico_sum_eq,
      constants.L_spec]

/-- `conditional_add_l self condition` returns `(carry, r)` where every limb of `r` is
below `2^52` and `r + 2^260 * (carry / 2^52) = self + (condition ? L : 0)`. -/
@[progress]
theorem conditional_add_l_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    conditional_add_l self condition ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r.2 + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if condition.val = 1#u8 then _root_.L else 0) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l
  progress as ⟨i, hi⟩
  progress as ⟨mask, hmask⟩
  have hmv : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hmask, hi]; simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, U64.size, U64.numBits]
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by norm_num)]
  progress with conditional_add_l_loop_spec as ⟨r, _, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
  refine ⟨hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
  have h := conditional_add_l_sum_split self (decide (condition.val = 1#u8))
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  rw [← h, ← conditional_add_l_Ico_sum_eq r.2]
  simpa using hr4

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

30	theorem sub_loop_step_arith (x y w : Nat) (hx : x < 2 ^ 52) (hy : y ≤ 2 ^ 52)
31	    (hw : w = (x + (2 ^ 64 - y)) % 2 ^ 64) :
32	    w / 2 ^ 63 ≤ 1 ∧ ((w % 2 ^ 52 : Nat) : Int) = (x : Int) - y + 2 ^ 52 * ((w / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) := by
33	  have h64 : (2 : Nat) ^ 64 = 18446744073709551616 := by norm_num
34	  have h63 : (2 : Nat) ^ 63 = 9223372036854775808 := by norm_num
35	  have h52 : (2 : Nat) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
36	  have h52' : (2 : Int) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
37	  rw [h64] at hw
38	  rw [h52] at hx hy ⊢
39	  rw [h63, h52']
40	  by_cases hxy : y ≤ x
41	  · have hw' : w = x - y := by omega
42	    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 0 := by omega
43	    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 = w := by omega
44	    rw [h1, h2, hw']
45	    constructor
46	    · omega

49	    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 1 := by omega
50	    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by omega
51	    rw [h1]

55	        exact_mod_cast h2
56	      push_cast; linarith

58	/-- Arithmetic heart of one iteration of `sub_loop`. -/

import Aeneas

set_option exponentiation.threshold 260

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open Aeneas.Std.WP
namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

attribute [-simp] Int.reducePow Nat.reducePow

def Scalar52_partial_as_Nat (limbs : Array U64 5#usize) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (limbs[j]!).val

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-- Arithmetic of one wrapping-subtraction step of `sub_loop`: for `x, y` small enough,
`w = x - y (mod 2^64)` has its top bit set exactly when `x < y`, and the low 52 bits of `w`
equal `x - y + 2^52 * (w >>> 63)`. -/
theorem sub_loop_step_arith (x y w : Nat) (hx : x < 2 ^ 52) (hy : y ≤ 2 ^ 52)
    (hw : w = (x + (2 ^ 64 - y)) % 2 ^ 64) :
    w / 2 ^ 63 ≤ 1 ∧ ((w % 2 ^ 52 : Nat) : Int) = (x : Int) - y + 2 ^ 52 * ((w / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) := by
  have h64 : (2 : Nat) ^ 64 = 18446744073709551616 := by norm_num
  have h63 : (2 : Nat) ^ 63 = 9223372036854775808 := by norm_num
  have h52 : (2 : Nat) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
  have h52' : (2 : Int) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
  rw [h64] at hw
  rw [h52] at hx hy ⊢
  rw [h63, h52']
  by_cases hxy : y ≤ x
  · have hw' : w = x - y := by omega
    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 0 := by omega
    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 = w := by omega
    rw [h1, h2, hw']
    constructor
    · omega
    · push_cast [hxy]; ring
  · have hw' : w + y = 18446744073709551616 + x := by omega
    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 1 := by omega
    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by omega
    rw [h1]
    constructor
    · omega
    · have h3 : ((w % 4503599627370496 : Nat) : Int) + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by
        exact_mod_cast h2
      push_cast; linarith

/-- Arithmetic heart of one iteration of `sub_loop`. -/
theorem sub_loop_post (a b r : Array U64 5#usize) (i : Nat) (f0 f1 F : Int) (hi : i < 5)
    (hri : ((r.val[i]!).val : Int) = (a.val[i]!).val - ((b.val[i]!).val + f0) + 2 ^ 52 * f1)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val - 2 ^ 260 * F =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * f1) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val - 2 ^ 260 * F =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
        2 ^ (52 * i) * f0 := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hp : (2 : Int) ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize (2 : Int) ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  linear_combination hrec

/-- `sub_loop a b difference mask borrow i` computes limbs `i..4` of `a - b` with borrow
propagation (the incoming borrow is `borrow >>> 63`), storing each limb modulo `2^52`.
The final borrow's top bit records the outgoing borrow:
`∑ r.1 - 2^260 * (r.2 >>> 63) = ∑ (a - b) - 2^(52 i) * (borrow >>> 63)` over limbs `i..4`. -/
@[progress]
theorem sub_loop_spec (a b difference : Scalar52) (mask borrow : U64) (i : Usize)
    (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hb : ∀ j, j < 5 → (b.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hd : ∀ j, j < 5 → (difference.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    sub_loop a b difference mask borrow i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.1.val[j]! = difference.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.1.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.2.val / 2 ^ 63 ≤ 1 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.1.val[j]!).val -
          2 ^ 260 * ((r.2.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) *
          (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * ((borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) ⦄ := by
  unfold sub_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨i1, hi1, hi1'⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2, hi2'⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3⟩
    have hi3v : i3.val = borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 := by simp [hi3, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi3lt : i3.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi3v]; scalar_tac
    have hai : i1.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi1']; exact ha i.val hilt
    have hbi : i2.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi2']; exact hb i.val hilt
    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
    progress as ⟨w, hw⟩
    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
    have hwv : w.val = (i1.val + (2 ^ 64 - i4.val)) % 2 ^ 64 := by
      rw [hw]; simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]
    obtain ⟨hwlt, hwmod⟩ := sub_loop_step_arith i1.val i4.val w.val hai (by omega) hwv
    have hi5v : i5.val = w.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
    have hs1i : ((back i5).val[i.val]!) = i5 := hback2 i5
    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = difference.val[j]! := hback3 i5
    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i.val
      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hd j hj
    have hdec : 5 - i6.val < 5 - i.val := by omega
    progress as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
    · rw [hi6] at hr4
      have hri : ((r.1.val[i.val]!).val : Int) = (a.val[i.val]!).val -
          ((b.val[i.val]!).val + ((borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int)) +
          2 ^ 52 * ((w.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) := by
        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v, hwmod, hi4, ← hi1', ← hi2', hi3v]
        push_cast; ring
      exact sub_loop_post a b r.1 i.val _ _ _ hilt hri hr4
  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
    rw [spec_ok]
    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hd, by scalar_tac, ?_⟩
    simp [hi5]
termination_by 5 - i.val
decreasing_by
  all_goals scalar_tac

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-- A scalar with all five limbs below `2^52` is below `2^260`. -/
theorem sub_as_Nat_lt (a : Scalar52) (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    Scalar52_as_Nat a < 2 ^ 260 := by
  have h0 := ha 0 (by omega)
  have h1 := ha 1 (by omega)
  have h2 := ha 2 (by omega)
  have h3 := ha 3 (by omega)
  have h4 := ha 4 (by omega)
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq]
  norm_num at h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 ⊢
  omega

/-- The signed limb-difference sum over `Ico 0 5` is `a - b`. -/
theorem sub_Ico_sum_sub (a b : Scalar52) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) =
      (Scalar52_as_Nat a : Int) - Scalar52_as_Nat b := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]

theorem mr_select_spec (a b : U64) (choice : subtle.Choice) :

      res = if choice.val = 1#u8 then b else a ⦄ := by

  split <;> simp_all

theorem mr_Ico_sum_eq (a : Scalar52) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (a.val[j]!).val = Scalar52_as_Nat a := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]

theorem mr_cadd_loop_post (self s1 r : Array U64 5#usize) (Lc : Nat → Nat)

    (hx : x = A + (self.val[i]!).val + Lc i)
    (hri : (r.val[i]!).val = x % 2 ^ 52)
    (hs1 : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s1.val[j]! = self.val[j]!)

    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =

  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]

    intro j hj
    rw [hs1 j (by simp at hj; omega)]

  have hsplit := Nat.mod_add_div x (2 ^ 52)
  have hp : 2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec

  generalize 2 ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  generalize x % 2 ^ 52 = z at *
  generalize x / 2 ^ 52 = y at *
  subst hx
  zify at *

/-- One Montgomery reduction step: `part1 sum` computes `p = sum * LFACTOR mod 2^52` and the

@[progress]
theorem part1_spec (sum : U128) (h : sum.val < 2 ^ 127) :
    part1 sum ⦃ r =>
      r.2.val < 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.2.val = sum.val * constants.LFACTOR.val % 2 ^ 52 ∧
      (sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 ∧
      r.1.val = (sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val) / 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val * 2 ^ 52 = sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val ⦄ := by
  unfold part1
  progress as ⟨ i, hi ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i1, hi1 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i2, hi2 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i3, hi3 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ p, hp ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i4, hi4, hi4' ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i5, hi5 ⟩
  have hL0 : i4.val = 671914833335277 := by rw [hi4', constants.L_val]; rfl
  have hLF := constants.LFACTOR_val
  have hi3v : i3.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hi3, hi2]; simp only [U64.size, U64.numBits, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; norm_num
  have hpv : p.val = sum.val * constants.LFACTOR.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
    rw [hp, UScalar.val_and, hi3v, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod, hi1,
      core.num.U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq, hi, UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    simp only [UScalarTy.numBits, show UScalar.size UScalarTy.U64 = 2 ^ 64 by simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]]
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64), Nat.mul_mod,
      Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64), ← Nat.mul_mod]
  have hplt : p.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hpv]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  have hdiv : (sum.val + p.val * i4.val) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 := by
    rw [hpv, hL0, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_mod, ← Nat.mul_mod, ← Nat.add_mod, hLF]
    have : sum.val + sum.val * 1439961107955227 * 671914833335277 =
        sum.val * (1439961107955227 * 671914833335277 + 1) := by ring
    rw [this, Nat.mul_mod]
    norm_num
  have hi5lt : i5.val < 2 ^ 102 := by
    rw [hi5, hL0]
    calc p.val * 671914833335277 < 2 ^ 52 * 2 ^ 50 :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le hplt (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      _ = 2 ^ 102 := by norm_num
  have hadd : sum.val + i5.val ≤ U128.max := by
    rw [U128.max_eq]
    have : (2 : ℕ) ^ 127 + 2 ^ 102 ≤ 340282366920938463463374607431768211455 := by norm_num
    omega
  progress as ⟨ i6, hi6 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i7, hi7 ⟩
  simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] at hi7
  rw [constants.L_limbs.1, ← hL0]
  refine ⟨hplt, hpv, hdiv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hi7, hi6, hi5]
  · rw [hi7, hi6, hi5]
    exact Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hdiv)

/-- Carry split: `part2 sum` returns the carry `sum / 2^52` and the low 52-bit limb
`sum % 2^52`. -/
@[progress]
theorem part2_spec (sum : U128) :
    part2 sum ⦃ r =>
      r.2.val < 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.2.val = sum.val % 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val = sum.val / 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 76 ∧
      r.1.val * 2 ^ 52 + r.2.val = sum.val ⦄ := by
  unfold part2
  progress as ⟨ i, hi ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i1, hi1 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i2, hi2 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ w, hw ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i3, hi3 ⟩
  simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] at hi3

    rw [hi2, hi1]; simp only [U64.size, U64.numBits, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; norm_num

    rw [hw, UScalar.val_and, hi2v, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod, hi, UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    simp only [UScalarTy.numBits,
      show UScalar.size UScalarTy.U64 = 2 ^ 64 by simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]]
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64)]
  have hs : sum.val < 2 ^ 128 := by scalar_tac
  refine ⟨?_, hwv, hi3, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hwv]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  · rw [hi3]; omega

/-- The linear carry-chain identity behind `montgomery_reduce`: the five reduction steps and

theorem montgomery_reduce_chain
    (t0 t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 t8 n0 n1 n2 n3 n4 c0 c1 c2 c3 c4 d5 d6 d7 d8 r0 r1 r2 r3 : ℕ)
    (e0 : c0 * 2 ^ 52 = t0 + n0 * 671914833335277)
    (e1 : c1 * 2 ^ 52 = c0 + t1 + n0 * 3916664325105025 + n1 * 671914833335277)
    (e2 : c2 * 2 ^ 52 = c1 + t2 + n0 * 1367801 + n1 * 3916664325105025 + n2 * 671914833335277)
    (e3 : c3 * 2 ^ 52 = c2 + t3 + n1 * 1367801 + n2 * 3916664325105025 + n3 * 671914833335277)
    (e4 : c4 * 2 ^ 52 = c3 + t4 + n0 * 17592186044416 + n2 * 1367801 + n3 * 3916664325105025 +
      n4 * 671914833335277)
    (e5 : d5 * 2 ^ 52 + r0 = c4 + t5 + n1 * 17592186044416 + n3 * 1367801 +
      n4 * 3916664325105025)
    (e6 : d6 * 2 ^ 52 + r1 = d5 + t6 + n2 * 17592186044416 + n4 * 1367801)
    (e7 : d7 * 2 ^ 52 + r2 = d6 + t7 + n3 * 17592186044416)
    (e8 : d8 * 2 ^ 52 + r3 = d7 + t8 + n4 * 17592186044416) :

theorem mr_select_spec (a b : U64) (choice : subtle.Choice) :

theorem mr_cadd_loop_post (self s1 r : Array U64 5#usize) (Lc : Nat → Nat)

    (hx : x = A + (self.val[i]!).val + Lc i)

    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hs1 j (by simp at hj; omega)]

  have hsplit := Nat.mod_add_div x (2 ^ 52)
  have hp : 2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring

    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) (hcarry : carry.val < 2 ^ 53) :
    conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.2.val[j]! = self.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧

  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨li, hli, hli'⟩
    progress with mr_select_spec as ⟨addend, haddend⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3, hi3'⟩
    have hLi : li.val < 2 ^ 52 := by

    have hselfi : i3.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi3']; exact hself i.val hilt
    have hi2v : i2.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 := by simp [hi2, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi2lt : i2.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi2v]; omega

    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩

      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]

    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = self.val[j]! := hback3 i5

/-- The underlying list of limbs of `L`. -/
theorem L_val : L.val = [671914833335277#u64, 3916664325105025#u64, 1367801#u64, 0#u64,
    17592186044416#u64] := by
  unfold L
  rfl

theorem L_limbs :
    L[0]!.val = 671914833335277 ∧ L[1]!.val = 3916664325105025 ∧
    L[2]!.val = 1367801 ∧ L[3]!.val = 0 ∧
    L[4]!.val = 17592186044416 := by
  simp only [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq, L_val]
  decide

/-- All limbs of `L` are bounded by `2^52`. -/
theorem L_bounds : ∀ i < 5, L[i]!.val < 2 ^ 52 := by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := L_limbs
  intro i hi
  interval_cases i <;> simp only [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4] <;> norm_num

/-- `L` represents the group order `ℓ = 2^252 + 27742317777372353535851937790883648493`. -/
@[simp]
theorem L_spec : Scalar52_as_Nat L = _root_.L := by

/-- `LFACTOR` fits in 52 bits. -/
theorem LFACTOR_bound : LFACTOR.val < 2 ^ 52 := by
  rw [LFACTOR_val]; norm_num

/-- `LFACTOR = -L⁻¹ mod 2^52`, stated on the low limb `L[0]`. -/
theorem LFACTOR_spec : (L[0]!.val * LFACTOR.val + 1) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 := by
  rw [L_limbs.1, LFACTOR_val]
  norm_num

/-- `LFACTOR = -L⁻¹ mod 2^52`, stated on the full group order. -/
theorem LFACTOR_spec_L : (_root_.L * LFACTOR.val + 1) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 := by

/-- One Montgomery reduction step: `part1 sum` computes `p = sum * LFACTOR mod 2^52` and the

@[progress]
theorem part1_spec (sum : U128) (h : sum.val < 2 ^ 127) :
    part1 sum ⦃ r =>
      r.2.val < 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.2.val = sum.val * constants.LFACTOR.val % 2 ^ 52 ∧
      (sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 ∧
      r.1.val = (sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val) / 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val * 2 ^ 52 = sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val ⦄ := by
  unfold part1
  progress as ⟨ i, hi ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i1, hi1 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i2, hi2 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i3, hi3 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ p, hp ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i4, hi4, hi4' ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i5, hi5 ⟩
  have hL0 : i4.val = 671914833335277 := by rw [hi4', constants.L_val]; rfl
  have hLF := constants.LFACTOR_val
  have hi3v : i3.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hi3, hi2]; simp only [U64.size, U64.numBits, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; norm_num
  have hpv : p.val = sum.val * constants.LFACTOR.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
    rw [hp, UScalar.val_and, hi3v, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod, hi1,
      core.num.U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq, hi, UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    simp only [UScalarTy.numBits, show UScalar.size UScalarTy.U64 = 2 ^ 64 by simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]]
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64), Nat.mul_mod,
      Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64), ← Nat.mul_mod]
  have hplt : p.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hpv]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  have hdiv : (sum.val + p.val * i4.val) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 := by
    rw [hpv, hL0, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_mod, ← Nat.mul_mod, ← Nat.add_mod, hLF]

    rw [this, Nat.mul_mod]
    norm_num
  have hi5lt : i5.val < 2 ^ 102 := by
    rw [hi5, hL0]

    rw [U128.max_eq]

@[progress]
theorem part2_spec (sum : U128) :
    part2 sum ⦃ r =>
      r.2.val < 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.2.val = sum.val % 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val = sum.val / 2 ^ 52 ∧

  progress as ⟨ i, hi ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i1, hi1 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i2, hi2 ⟩

  progress as ⟨ i3, hi3 ⟩

    rw [hi2, hi1]; simp only [U64.size, U64.numBits, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; norm_num

    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64)]

  · rw [hwv]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  · rw [hi3]; omega
  · rw [hi3, hwv]; exact Nat.div_add_mod' _ _

  generalize x % 2 ^ 52 = z at *

/-- The underlying list of limbs of `L`. -/
theorem L_val : L.val = [671914833335277#u64, 3916664325105025#u64, 1367801#u64, 0#u64,
    17592186044416#u64] := by
  unfold L
  rfl

/-- The limbs of `L` as natural numbers. -/
theorem L_limbs :
    L[0]!.val = 671914833335277 ∧ L[1]!.val = 3916664325105025 ∧
    L[2]!.val = 1367801 ∧ L[3]!.val = 0 ∧
    L[4]!.val = 17592186044416 := by
  simp only [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq, L_val]
  decide

/-- All limbs of `L` are bounded by `2^52`. -/
theorem L_bounds : ∀ i < 5, L[i]!.val < 2 ^ 52 := by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := L_limbs
  intro i hi
  interval_cases i <;> simp only [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4] <;> norm_num

/-- `L` represents the group order `ℓ = 2^252 + 27742317777372353535851937790883648493`. -/
@[simp]
theorem L_spec : Scalar52_as_Nat L = _root_.L := by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := L_limbs
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, h0, h1, h2, h3, h4]
  unfold _root_.L
  rfl

/-- The value of `LFACTOR`. -/
@[simp]
theorem LFACTOR_val : LFACTOR.val = 1439961107955227 := by
  unfold LFACTOR
  rfl

/-- `LFACTOR` fits in 52 bits. -/
theorem LFACTOR_bound : LFACTOR.val < 2 ^ 52 := by
  rw [LFACTOR_val]; norm_num

/-- `LFACTOR = -L⁻¹ mod 2^52`, stated on the low limb `L[0]`. -/
theorem LFACTOR_spec : (L[0]!.val * LFACTOR.val + 1) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 := by
  rw [L_limbs.1, LFACTOR_val]
  norm_num

/-- `LFACTOR = -L⁻¹ mod 2^52`, stated on the full group order. -/
theorem LFACTOR_spec_L : (_root_.L * LFACTOR.val + 1) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 := by
  rw [LFACTOR_val]
  unfold _root_.L
  norm_num

/-- One Montgomery reduction step: `part1 sum` computes `p = sum * LFACTOR mod 2^52` and the
carry `(sum + p * L[0]) / 2^52`, where the division is exact. -/
@[progress]
theorem part1_spec (sum : U128) (h : sum.val < 2 ^ 127) :
    part1 sum ⦃ r =>
      r.2.val < 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.2.val = sum.val * constants.LFACTOR.val % 2 ^ 52 ∧
      (sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 ∧
      r.1.val = (sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val) / 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val * 2 ^ 52 = sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val ⦄ := by
  unfold part1
  progress as ⟨ i, hi ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i1, hi1 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i2, hi2 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i3, hi3 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ p, hp ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i4, hi4, hi4' ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i5, hi5 ⟩
  have hL0 : i4.val = 671914833335277 := by rw [hi4', constants.L_val]; rfl
  have hLF := constants.LFACTOR_val
  have hi3v : i3.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hi3, hi2]; simp only [U64.size, U64.numBits, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; norm_num
  have hpv : p.val = sum.val * constants.LFACTOR.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
    rw [hp, UScalar.val_and, hi3v, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod, hi1,
      core.num.U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq, hi, UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    simp only [UScalarTy.numBits, show UScalar.size UScalarTy.U64 = 2 ^ 64 by simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]]
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64), Nat.mul_mod,
      Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64), ← Nat.mul_mod]
  have hplt : p.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hpv]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  have hdiv : (sum.val + p.val * i4.val) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 := by
    rw [hpv, hL0, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_mod, ← Nat.mul_mod, ← Nat.add_mod, hLF]
    have : sum.val + sum.val * 1439961107955227 * 671914833335277 =
        sum.val * (1439961107955227 * 671914833335277 + 1) := by ring
    rw [this, Nat.mul_mod]
    norm_num
  have hi5lt : i5.val < 2 ^ 102 := by
    rw [hi5, hL0]
    calc p.val * 671914833335277 < 2 ^ 52 * 2 ^ 50 :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le hplt (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      _ = 2 ^ 102 := by norm_num
  have hadd : sum.val + i5.val ≤ U128.max := by
    rw [U128.max_eq]
    have : (2 : ℕ) ^ 127 + 2 ^ 102 ≤ 340282366920938463463374607431768211455 := by norm_num
    omega
  progress as ⟨ i6, hi6 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i7, hi7 ⟩
  simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] at hi7
  rw [constants.L_limbs.1, ← hL0]
  refine ⟨hplt, hpv, hdiv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hi7, hi6, hi5]
  · rw [hi7, hi6, hi5]
    exact Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hdiv)

/-- Carry split: `part2 sum` returns the carry `sum / 2^52` and the low 52-bit limb
`sum % 2^52`. -/
@[progress]
theorem part2_spec (sum : U128) :
    part2 sum ⦃ r =>
      r.2.val < 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.2.val = sum.val % 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val = sum.val / 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 76 ∧
      r.1.val * 2 ^ 52 + r.2.val = sum.val ⦄ := by
  unfold part2
  progress as ⟨ i, hi ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i1, hi1 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i2, hi2 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ w, hw ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i3, hi3 ⟩
  simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] at hi3
  have hi2v : i2.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hi2, hi1]; simp only [U64.size, U64.numBits, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; norm_num
  have hwv : w.val = sum.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
    rw [hw, UScalar.val_and, hi2v, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod, hi, UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    simp only [UScalarTy.numBits,
      show UScalar.size UScalarTy.U64 = 2 ^ 64 by simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]]
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64)]
  have hs : sum.val < 2 ^ 128 := by scalar_tac
  refine ⟨?_, hwv, hi3, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hwv]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  · rw [hi3]; omega
  · rw [hi3, hwv]; exact Nat.div_add_mod' _ _

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52.montgomery_reduce

/-- The linear carry-chain identity behind `montgomery_reduce`: the five reduction steps and
four carry splits combine into `A * 2^260 = T + N * L`. -/
theorem montgomery_reduce_chain
    (t0 t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 t8 n0 n1 n2 n3 n4 c0 c1 c2 c3 c4 d5 d6 d7 d8 r0 r1 r2 r3 : ℕ)
    (e0 : c0 * 2 ^ 52 = t0 + n0 * 671914833335277)
    (e1 : c1 * 2 ^ 52 = c0 + t1 + n0 * 3916664325105025 + n1 * 671914833335277)
    (e2 : c2 * 2 ^ 52 = c1 + t2 + n0 * 1367801 + n1 * 3916664325105025 + n2 * 671914833335277)
    (e3 : c3 * 2 ^ 52 = c2 + t3 + n1 * 1367801 + n2 * 3916664325105025 + n3 * 671914833335277)
    (e4 : c4 * 2 ^ 52 = c3 + t4 + n0 * 17592186044416 + n2 * 1367801 + n3 * 3916664325105025 +
      n4 * 671914833335277)
    (e5 : d5 * 2 ^ 52 + r0 = c4 + t5 + n1 * 17592186044416 + n3 * 1367801 +
      n4 * 3916664325105025)
    (e6 : d6 * 2 ^ 52 + r1 = d5 + t6 + n2 * 17592186044416 + n4 * 1367801)
    (e7 : d7 * 2 ^ 52 + r2 = d6 + t7 + n3 * 17592186044416)
    (e8 : d8 * 2 ^ 52 + r3 = d7 + t8 + n4 * 17592186044416) :
    (r0 + 2 ^ 52 * r1 + 2 ^ 104 * r2 + 2 ^ 156 * r3 + 2 ^ 208 * d8) * 2 ^ 260 =
      (t0 + 2 ^ 52 * t1 + 2 ^ 104 * t2 + 2 ^ 156 * t3 + 2 ^ 208 * t4 + 2 ^ 260 * t5 +
        2 ^ 312 * t6 + 2 ^ 364 * t7 + 2 ^ 416 * t8) +
      (n0 + 2 ^ 52 * n1 + 2 ^ 104 * n2 + 2 ^ 156 * n3 + 2 ^ 208 * n4) * _root_.L := by
  unfold _root_.L
  omega

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

`ConditionalAddL.lean` (and hence `Sub.lean`) imports this module for the `L` constant lemmas,

theorem mr_select_spec (a b : U64) (choice : subtle.Choice) :
    U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select a b choice ⦃ res =>
      res = if choice.val = 1#u8 then b else a ⦄ := by
  unfold U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select
  split <;> simp_all

theorem mr_Ico_sum_eq (a : Scalar52) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (a.val[j]!).val = Scalar52_as_Nat a := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]

theorem mr_cadd_loop_post (self s1 r : Array U64 5#usize) (Lc : Nat → Nat)
    (i A x c' : Nat) (hi : i < 5)
    (hx : x = A + (self.val[i]!).val + Lc i)
    (hri : (r.val[i]!).val = x % 2 ^ 52)
    (hs1 : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s1.val[j]! = self.val[j]!)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * (x / 2 ^ 52)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * i) * A := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hs : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hs1 j (by simp at hj; omega)]
  rw [hs] at hrec
  have hsplit := Nat.mod_add_div x (2 ^ 52)
  have hp : 2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize 2 ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  generalize x % 2 ^ 52 = z at *
  generalize x / 2 ^ 52 = y at *
  subst hx
  zify at *
  linear_combination hrec + P * hsplit

theorem mr_cadd_loop_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (carry mask : U64) (i : Usize) (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) (hcarry : carry.val < 2 ^ 53) :
    conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.2.val[j]! = self.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.2.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
          (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) +
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨li, hli, hli'⟩
    progress with mr_select_spec as ⟨addend, haddend⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3, hi3'⟩
    have hLi : li.val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hli']; simpa [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using constants.L_bounds i.val hilt
    have hadd : addend.val =
        (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[i.val]!).val else 0) := by
      rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hadd_lt : addend.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hselfi : i3.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi3']; exact hself i.val hilt
    have hi2v : i2.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 := by simp [hi2, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi2lt : i2.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi2v]; omega
    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
    progress as ⟨carry1, hc1⟩
    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
    have hc1v : carry1.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 + (self.val[i.val]!).val + addend.val := by
      rw [hc1, hi4, hi2v, hi3']
    have hc1lt : carry1.val < 2 ^ 53 := by omega
    have hi5v : i5.val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
    have hs1i : ((back i5).val[i.val]!) = i5 := hback2 i5
    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = self.val[j]! := hback3 i5
    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i.val
      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hself j hj
    have hdec : 5 - i6.val < 5 - i.val := by omega
    progress with mr_cadd_loop_spec as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
    · rw [hi6] at hr4
      have hri : (r.2.val[i.val]!).val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v]
      exact mr_cadd_loop_post self (back i5) r.2
        (fun j => if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)
        i.val (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) carry1.val (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) hilt
        (by rw [hc1v, hadd]) hri hs1ne hr4
  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
    rw [spec_ok]
    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hself, hcarry, ?_⟩
    simp [hi5]
termination_by 5 - i.val
decreasing_by
  all_goals scalar_tac

theorem mr_cadd_sum_split (self : Scalar52) (b : Bool) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
      (if b then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) =
      Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if b then _root_.L else 0) := by
  rw [← mr_Ico_sum_eq self]
  cases b
  · simp
  · simp only [if_true, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mr_Ico_sum_eq,
      constants.L_spec]

theorem mr_cadd_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    conditional_add_l self condition ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r.2 + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if condition.val = 1#u8 then _root_.L else 0) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l
  progress as ⟨i, hi⟩
  progress as ⟨mask, hmask⟩
  have hmv : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hmask, hi]; simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, U64.size, U64.numBits]
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by norm_num)]
  progress with mr_cadd_loop_spec as ⟨r, _, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
  refine ⟨hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
  have h := mr_cadd_sum_split self (decide (condition.val = 1#u8))
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  rw [← h, ← mr_Ico_sum_eq r.2]
  simpa using hr4

theorem mr_sub_loop_step_arith (x y w : Nat) (hx : x < 2 ^ 52) (hy : y ≤ 2 ^ 52)

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.constants

/-- The underlying list of limbs of `L`. -/
theorem L_val : L.val = [671914833335277#u64, 3916664325105025#u64, 1367801#u64, 0#u64,
    17592186044416#u64] := by
  unfold L
  rfl

/-- The limbs of `L` as natural numbers. -/
theorem L_limbs :
    L[0]!.val = 671914833335277 ∧ L[1]!.val = 3916664325105025 ∧
    L[2]!.val = 1367801 ∧ L[3]!.val = 0 ∧
    L[4]!.val = 17592186044416 := by
  simp only [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq, L_val]
  decide

/-- All limbs of `L` are bounded by `2^52`. -/
theorem L_bounds : ∀ i < 5, L[i]!.val < 2 ^ 52 := by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := L_limbs
  intro i hi
  interval_cases i <;> simp only [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4] <;> norm_num

/-- `L` represents the group order `ℓ = 2^252 + 27742317777372353535851937790883648493`. -/
@[simp]
theorem L_spec : Scalar52_as_Nat L = _root_.L := by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := L_limbs
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, h0, h1, h2, h3, h4]
  unfold _root_.L
  rfl

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.constants

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.constants

/-- The value of `LFACTOR`. -/
@[simp]
theorem LFACTOR_val : LFACTOR.val = 1439961107955227 := by
  unfold LFACTOR
  rfl

/-- `LFACTOR` fits in 52 bits. -/
theorem LFACTOR_bound : LFACTOR.val < 2 ^ 52 := by
  rw [LFACTOR_val]; norm_num

/-- `LFACTOR = -L⁻¹ mod 2^52`, stated on the low limb `L[0]`. -/
theorem LFACTOR_spec : (L[0]!.val * LFACTOR.val + 1) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 := by
  rw [L_limbs.1, LFACTOR_val]
  norm_num

/-- `LFACTOR = -L⁻¹ mod 2^52`, stated on the full group order. -/
theorem LFACTOR_spec_L : (_root_.L * LFACTOR.val + 1) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 := by
  rw [LFACTOR_val]
  unfold _root_.L
  norm_num

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.constants

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52.montgomery_reduce


/-- One Montgomery reduction step: `part1 sum` computes `p = sum * LFACTOR mod 2^52` and the
carry `(sum + p * L[0]) / 2^52`, where the division is exact. -/
@[progress]
theorem part1_spec (sum : U128) (h : sum.val < 2 ^ 127) :
    part1 sum ⦃ r =>
      r.2.val < 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.2.val = sum.val * constants.LFACTOR.val % 2 ^ 52 ∧
      (sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 ∧
      r.1.val = (sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val) / 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val * 2 ^ 52 = sum.val + r.2.val * constants.L[0]!.val ⦄ := by
  unfold part1
  progress as ⟨ i, hi ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i1, hi1 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i2, hi2 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i3, hi3 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ p, hp ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i4, hi4, hi4' ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i5, hi5 ⟩
  have hL0 : i4.val = 671914833335277 := by rw [hi4', constants.L_val]; rfl
  have hLF := constants.LFACTOR_val
  have hi3v : i3.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hi3, hi2]; simp only [U64.size, U64.numBits, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; norm_num
  have hpv : p.val = sum.val * constants.LFACTOR.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
    rw [hp, UScalar.val_and, hi3v, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod, hi1,
      core.num.U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq, hi, UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    simp only [UScalarTy.numBits, show UScalar.size UScalarTy.U64 = 2 ^ 64 by simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]]
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64), Nat.mul_mod,
      Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64), ← Nat.mul_mod]
  have hplt : p.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hpv]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  have hdiv : (sum.val + p.val * i4.val) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 := by
    rw [hpv, hL0, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_mod, ← Nat.mul_mod, ← Nat.add_mod, hLF]
    have : sum.val + sum.val * 1439961107955227 * 671914833335277 =
        sum.val * (1439961107955227 * 671914833335277 + 1) := by ring
    rw [this, Nat.mul_mod]
    norm_num
  have hi5lt : i5.val < 2 ^ 102 := by
    rw [hi5, hL0]
    calc p.val * 671914833335277 < 2 ^ 52 * 2 ^ 50 :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le hplt (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      _ = 2 ^ 102 := by norm_num
  have hadd : sum.val + i5.val ≤ U128.max := by
    rw [U128.max_eq]
    have : (2 : ℕ) ^ 127 + 2 ^ 102 ≤ 340282366920938463463374607431768211455 := by norm_num
    omega
  progress as ⟨ i6, hi6 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i7, hi7 ⟩
  simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] at hi7
  rw [constants.L_limbs.1, ← hL0]
  refine ⟨hplt, hpv, hdiv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hi7, hi6, hi5]
  · rw [hi7, hi6, hi5]
    exact Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hdiv)

/-- Carry split: `part2 sum` returns the carry `sum / 2^52` and the low 52-bit limb
`sum % 2^52`. -/
@[progress]
theorem part2_spec (sum : U128) :
    part2 sum ⦃ r =>
      r.2.val < 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.2.val = sum.val % 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val = sum.val / 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 76 ∧
      r.1.val * 2 ^ 52 + r.2.val = sum.val ⦄ := by
  unfold part2
  progress as ⟨ i, hi ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i1, hi1 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i2, hi2 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ w, hw ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i3, hi3 ⟩
  simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] at hi3
  have hi2v : i2.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hi2, hi1]; simp only [U64.size, U64.numBits, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; norm_num
  have hwv : w.val = sum.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
    rw [hw, UScalar.val_and, hi2v, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod, hi, UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    simp only [UScalarTy.numBits,
      show UScalar.size UScalarTy.U64 = 2 ^ 64 by simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]]
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64)]
  have hs : sum.val < 2 ^ 128 := by scalar_tac
  refine ⟨?_, hwv, hi3, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hwv]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  · rw [hi3]; omega
  · rw [hi3, hwv]; exact Nat.div_add_mod' _ _

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52.montgomery_reduce

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-- The linear carry-chain identity behind `montgomery_reduce`: the five reduction steps and
four carry splits combine into `A * 2^260 = T + N * L`. -/
theorem montgomery_reduce_chain
    (t0 t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 t8 n0 n1 n2 n3 n4 c0 c1 c2 c3 c4 d5 d6 d7 d8 r0 r1 r2 r3 : ℕ)
    (e0 : c0 * 2 ^ 52 = t0 + n0 * 671914833335277)
    (e1 : c1 * 2 ^ 52 = c0 + t1 + n0 * 3916664325105025 + n1 * 671914833335277)
    (e2 : c2 * 2 ^ 52 = c1 + t2 + n0 * 1367801 + n1 * 3916664325105025 + n2 * 671914833335277)
    (e3 : c3 * 2 ^ 52 = c2 + t3 + n1 * 1367801 + n2 * 3916664325105025 + n3 * 671914833335277)
    (e4 : c4 * 2 ^ 52 = c3 + t4 + n0 * 17592186044416 + n2 * 1367801 + n3 * 3916664325105025 +
      n4 * 671914833335277)
    (e5 : d5 * 2 ^ 52 + r0 = c4 + t5 + n1 * 17592186044416 + n3 * 1367801 +
      n4 * 3916664325105025)
    (e6 : d6 * 2 ^ 52 + r1 = d5 + t6 + n2 * 17592186044416 + n4 * 1367801)
    (e7 : d7 * 2 ^ 52 + r2 = d6 + t7 + n3 * 17592186044416)
    (e8 : d8 * 2 ^ 52 + r3 = d7 + t8 + n4 * 17592186044416) :
    (r0 + 2 ^ 52 * r1 + 2 ^ 104 * r2 + 2 ^ 156 * r3 + 2 ^ 208 * d8) * 2 ^ 260 =
      (t0 + 2 ^ 52 * t1 + 2 ^ 104 * t2 + 2 ^ 156 * t3 + 2 ^ 208 * t4 + 2 ^ 260 * t5 +
        2 ^ 312 * t6 + 2 ^ 364 * t7 + 2 ^ 416 * t8) +
      (n0 + 2 ^ 52 * n1 + 2 ^ 104 * n2 + 2 ^ 156 * n3 + 2 ^ 208 * n4) * _root_.L := by
  unfold _root_.L
  omega

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-! ### Local copies of the `conditional_add_l` / `sub` specifications

`ConditionalAddL.lean` (and hence `Sub.lean`) imports this module for the `L` constant lemmas,
so `sub_spec` cannot be imported here without an import cycle. The following duplicates
(with `mr_` names, not tagged `@[progress]`) are used only to prove `montgomery_reduce_spec`. -/

set_option exponentiation.threshold 500

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

attribute [-simp] Int.reducePow Nat.reducePow

theorem mr_select_spec (a b : U64) (choice : subtle.Choice) :
    U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select a b choice ⦃ res =>
      res = if choice.val = 1#u8 then b else a ⦄ := by
  unfold U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select
  split <;> simp_all

theorem mr_Ico_sum_eq (a : Scalar52) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (a.val[j]!).val = Scalar52_as_Nat a := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]

theorem mr_cadd_loop_post (self s1 r : Array U64 5#usize) (Lc : Nat → Nat)
    (i A x c' : Nat) (hi : i < 5)
    (hx : x = A + (self.val[i]!).val + Lc i)
    (hri : (r.val[i]!).val = x % 2 ^ 52)
    (hs1 : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s1.val[j]! = self.val[j]!)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * (x / 2 ^ 52)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * i) * A := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hs : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hs1 j (by simp at hj; omega)]
  rw [hs] at hrec
  have hsplit := Nat.mod_add_div x (2 ^ 52)
  have hp : 2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize 2 ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  generalize x % 2 ^ 52 = z at *
  generalize x / 2 ^ 52 = y at *
  subst hx
  zify at *
  linear_combination hrec + P * hsplit

theorem mr_cadd_loop_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (carry mask : U64) (i : Usize) (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) (hcarry : carry.val < 2 ^ 53) :
    conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.2.val[j]! = self.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.2.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
          (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) +
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨li, hli, hli'⟩
    progress with mr_select_spec as ⟨addend, haddend⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3, hi3'⟩
    have hLi : li.val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hli']; simpa [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using constants.L_bounds i.val hilt
    have hadd : addend.val =
        (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[i.val]!).val else 0) := by
      rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hadd_lt : addend.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hselfi : i3.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi3']; exact hself i.val hilt
    have hi2v : i2.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 := by simp [hi2, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi2lt : i2.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi2v]; omega
    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
    progress as ⟨carry1, hc1⟩
    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
    have hc1v : carry1.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 + (self.val[i.val]!).val + addend.val := by
      rw [hc1, hi4, hi2v, hi3']
    have hc1lt : carry1.val < 2 ^ 53 := by omega
    have hi5v : i5.val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
    have hs1i : ((back i5).val[i.val]!) = i5 := hback2 i5
    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = self.val[j]! := hback3 i5
    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i.val
      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hself j hj
    have hdec : 5 - i6.val < 5 - i.val := by omega
    progress with mr_cadd_loop_spec as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
    · rw [hi6] at hr4
      have hri : (r.2.val[i.val]!).val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v]
      exact mr_cadd_loop_post self (back i5) r.2
        (fun j => if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)
        i.val (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) carry1.val (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) hilt
        (by rw [hc1v, hadd]) hri hs1ne hr4
  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
    rw [spec_ok]
    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hself, hcarry, ?_⟩
    simp [hi5]
termination_by 5 - i.val
decreasing_by
  all_goals scalar_tac

theorem mr_cadd_sum_split (self : Scalar52) (b : Bool) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
      (if b then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) =
      Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if b then _root_.L else 0) := by
  rw [← mr_Ico_sum_eq self]
  cases b
  · simp
  · simp only [if_true, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mr_Ico_sum_eq,
      constants.L_spec]

theorem mr_cadd_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    conditional_add_l self condition ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r.2 + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if condition.val = 1#u8 then _root_.L else 0) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l
  progress as ⟨i, hi⟩
  progress as ⟨mask, hmask⟩
  have hmv : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hmask, hi]; simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, U64.size, U64.numBits]
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by norm_num)]
  progress with mr_cadd_loop_spec as ⟨r, _, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
  refine ⟨hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
  have h := mr_cadd_sum_split self (decide (condition.val = 1#u8))
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  rw [← h, ← mr_Ico_sum_eq r.2]
  simpa using hr4

theorem mr_sub_loop_step_arith (x y w : Nat) (hx : x < 2 ^ 52) (hy : y ≤ 2 ^ 52)
    (hw : w = (x + (2 ^ 64 - y)) % 2 ^ 64) :
    w / 2 ^ 63 ≤ 1 ∧
      ((w % 2 ^ 52 : Nat) : Int) = (x : Int) - y + 2 ^ 52 * ((w / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) := by
  have h64 : (2 : Nat) ^ 64 = 18446744073709551616 := by norm_num
  have h63 : (2 : Nat) ^ 63 = 9223372036854775808 := by norm_num
  have h52 : (2 : Nat) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
  have h52' : (2 : Int) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
  rw [h64] at hw
  rw [h52] at hx hy ⊢
  rw [h63, h52']
  by_cases hxy : y ≤ x
  · have hw' : w = x - y := by omega
    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 0 := by omega
    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 = w := by omega
    rw [h1, h2, hw']
    constructor
    · omega
    · push_cast [hxy]; ring
  · have hw' : w + y = 18446744073709551616 + x := by omega
    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 1 := by omega
    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by omega
    rw [h1]
    constructor
    · omega
    · have h3 : ((w % 4503599627370496 : Nat) : Int) + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by
        exact_mod_cast h2
      push_cast; linarith

theorem mr_sub_loop_post (a b r : Array U64 5#usize) (i : Nat) (f0 f1 F : Int) (hi : i < 5)
    (hri : ((r.val[i]!).val : Int) = (a.val[i]!).val - ((b.val[i]!).val + f0) + 2 ^ 52 * f1)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val - 2 ^ 260 * F =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5,
          (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * f1) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val - 2 ^ 260 * F =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
        2 ^ (52 * i) * f0 := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hp : (2 : Int) ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize (2 : Int) ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  linear_combination hrec

theorem mr_sub_loop_spec (a b difference : Scalar52) (mask borrow : U64) (i : Usize)
    (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hb : ∀ j, j < 5 → (b.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hd : ∀ j, j < 5 → (difference.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    sub_loop a b difference mask borrow i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.1.val[j]! = difference.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.1.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.2.val / 2 ^ 63 ≤ 1 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.1.val[j]!).val -
          2 ^ 260 * ((r.2.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) *
          (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * ((borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) ⦄ := by
  unfold sub_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨i1, hi1, hi1'⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2, hi2'⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3⟩
    have hi3v : i3.val = borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 := by simp [hi3, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi3lt : i3.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi3v]; scalar_tac
    have hai : i1.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi1']; exact ha i.val hilt
    have hbi : i2.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi2']; exact hb i.val hilt
    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
    progress as ⟨w, hw⟩
    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
    have hwv : w.val = (i1.val + (2 ^ 64 - i4.val)) % 2 ^ 64 := by
      rw [hw]; simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]
    obtain ⟨hwlt, hwmod⟩ := mr_sub_loop_step_arith i1.val i4.val w.val hai (by omega) hwv
    have hi5v : i5.val = w.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
    have hs1i : ((back i5).val[i.val]!) = i5 := hback2 i5
    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = difference.val[j]! := hback3 i5
    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i.val
      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hd j hj
    have hdec : 5 - i6.val < 5 - i.val := by omega
    progress with mr_sub_loop_spec as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
    · rw [hi6] at hr4
      have hri : ((r.1.val[i.val]!).val : Int) = (a.val[i.val]!).val -
          ((b.val[i.val]!).val + ((borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int)) +
          2 ^ 52 * ((w.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) := by
        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v, hwmod, hi4, ← hi1', ← hi2', hi3v]
        push_cast; ring
      exact mr_sub_loop_post a b r.1 i.val _ _ _ hilt hri hr4
  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
    rw [spec_ok]
    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hd, by scalar_tac, ?_⟩
    simp [hi5]
termination_by 5 - i.val
decreasing_by
  all_goals scalar_tac

theorem mr_as_Nat_lt (a : Scalar52) (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    Scalar52_as_Nat a < 2 ^ 260 := by
  have h0 := ha 0 (by omega)
  have h1 := ha 1 (by omega)
  have h2 := ha 2 (by omega)
  have h3 := ha 3 (by omega)
  have h4 := ha 4 (by omega)
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq]
  norm_num at h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 ⊢
  omega

theorem mr_Ico_sum_sub (a b : Scalar52) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) =
      (Scalar52_as_Nat a : Int) - Scalar52_as_Nat b := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]
  push_cast
  ring

theorem mr_sub_final_arith (A B D R f q : Nat) (hf : f ≤ 1) (hD : D < 2 ^ 260)
    (hR : R < 2 ^ 260) (hBA : B ≤ A + _root_.L)
    (hloop : (D : Int) - 2 ^ 260 * f = (A : Int) - B)
    (hadd : R + 2 ^ 260 * q = D + (if f = 1 then _root_.L else 0)) :
    R + B = A + (if A < B then _root_.L else 0) := by
  have hL : _root_.L < 2 ^ 260 := by unfold _root_.L; norm_num
  have h260 : (2 : Nat) ^ 260 =
      1852673427797059126777135760139006525652319754650249024631321344126610074238976 := by
    norm_num
  have h260' : (2 : Int) ^ 260 =
      1852673427797059126777135760139006525652319754650249024631321344126610074238976 := by
    norm_num
  rw [h260'] at hloop
  rw [h260] at hD hR hadd hL
  generalize _root_.L = L at *
  rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hf with rfl | rfl
  · simp at hadd
    have hAB : ¬ A < B := by omega
    simp only [hAB, if_false]
    omega
  · simp at hadd
    have hAB : A < B := by omega
    simp only [hAB, if_true]
    omega

theorem mr_choice_from_spec (x : U8) (h : x.val ≤ 1) :
    subtle.Choice.Insts.CoreConvertFromU8.from x ⦃ c => c.val = x ⦄ := by
  unfold subtle.Choice.Insts.CoreConvertFromU8.from
  split
  · simp
  · split
    · simp
    · exfalso
      rename_i h1 h2
      have : x.val = 0 ∨ x.val = 1 := by omega
      rcases this with h3 | h3
      · exact h1 (by scalar_tac)
      · exact h2 (by scalar_tac)

/-- Local copy of (the first two conjuncts of) `sub_spec`; see the note above. -/
theorem mr_sub_spec (a b : Scalar52)
    (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hb : ∀ j, j < 5 → (b.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hab : Scalar52_as_Nat b ≤ Scalar52_as_Nat a + _root_.L) :
    sub a b ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r + Scalar52_as_Nat b =
        Scalar52_as_Nat a +
          (if Scalar52_as_Nat a < Scalar52_as_Nat b then _root_.L else 0) ⦄ := by
  unfold sub
  progress as ⟨i, hi⟩
  progress as ⟨mask, hmask⟩
  have hmv : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hmask, hi]; simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, U64.size, U64.numBits]
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by norm_num)]
  have hz : ∀ j, j < 5 → (ZERO.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
    intro j _; rw [ZERO_val_getElem!]; simp
  progress with mr_sub_loop_spec as ⟨d, _, hd2, hd3, hd4⟩
  progress as ⟨i1, hi1⟩
  progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
  have hi1v : i1.val = d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 := by simp [hi1, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  have hi2v : i2.val = d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 := by
    rw [← hi1v, hi2, UScalar.cast_val_eq]; simp; omega
  progress with mr_choice_from_spec as ⟨c, hc⟩
  progress with mr_cadd_spec as ⟨res, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩
  have hcond : (c.val = 1#u8) ↔ d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 = 1 := by
    rw [hc]; constructor
    · intro h; rw [← hi2v, h]; rfl
    · intro h; apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; rw [hi2v, h]; rfl
  have hD := mr_as_Nat_lt d.1 hd2
  have hR := mr_as_Nat_lt res.2 hr1
  have hloop : (Scalar52_as_Nat d.1 : Int) - 2 ^ 260 * ((d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) =
      (Scalar52_as_Nat a : Int) - Scalar52_as_Nat b := by
    rw [← mr_Ico_sum_sub, ← mr_Ico_sum_eq d.1]
    simpa using hd4
  have hadd : Scalar52_as_Nat res.2 + 2 ^ 260 * (res.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
      Scalar52_as_Nat d.1 + (if d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 = 1 then _root_.L else 0) := by
    rw [hr3]; simp only [hcond]
  exact ⟨hr1, mr_sub_final_arith _ _ _ _ _ _ hd3 hD hR hab hloop hadd⟩

/-- Expansion of the 9-limb (radix `2^52`) value of a `montgomery_reduce` input. -/
theorem montgomery_reduce_wide_expand (limbs : Array U128 9#usize) :

      (limbs.val[0]!).val + 2 ^ 52 * (limbs.val[1]!).val + 2 ^ 104 * (limbs.val[2]!).val +
      2 ^ 156 * (limbs.val[3]!).val + 2 ^ 208 * (limbs.val[4]!).val +
      2 ^ 260 * (limbs.val[5]!).val + 2 ^ 312 * (limbs.val[6]!).val +
      2 ^ 364 * (limbs.val[7]!).val + 2 ^ 416 * (limbs.val[8]!).val := by
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq]

/-- Value of a `Scalar52` built from an explicit list of five limbs. -/
theorem montgomery_reduce_make_as_Nat (r0 r1 r2 r3 r4 : U64)
    (h : [r0, r1, r2, r3, r4].length = (5#usize).val) :
    Scalar52_as_Nat (Array.make 5#usize [r0, r1, r2, r3, r4] h) =
      r0.val + 2 ^ 52 * r1.val + 2 ^ 104 * r2.val + 2 ^ 156 * r3.val + 2 ^ 208 * r4.val := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq, Array.make]

/-- Limb bounds of a `Scalar52` built from an explicit list of five limbs. -/
theorem montgomery_reduce_make_bounds (r0 r1 r2 r3 r4 : U64)
    (h : [r0, r1, r2, r3, r4].length = (5#usize).val)

theorem montgomery_reduce_make_bounds (r0 r1 r2 r3 r4 : U64)
    (h : [r0, r1, r2, r3, r4].length = (5#usize).val)
    (h0 : r0.val < 2 ^ 52) (h1 : r1.val < 2 ^ 52) (h2 : r2.val < 2 ^ 52)
    (h3 : r3.val < 2 ^ 52) (h4 : r4.val < 2 ^ 52) :
    ∀ j, j < 5 → ((Array.make 5#usize [r0, r1, r2, r3, r4] h).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
  intro j hj
  have : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 ∨ j = 3 ∨ j = 4 := by omega
